d2_fired.cognition_required: The --intent bytes that become enforceable review acceptance criteria were authored by an agent, because --intent is the only channel by which caller-side evidence reaches the reviewer and there is no structured-criteria input port.
d2_fired.eliminating_machinery: A structured criteria port on axi run (--criteria-file taking the plan's Verification Contract as typed data), or a deterministic serializer that renders that contract into intent bytes.
